About the Shop

One chair on Dawson Road.

Anthony Ross Sr. — Ant — is the owner and the only barber at Cutz by Ant Da Barber LLC. Every review on Booksy has his name on it.

The Story

Old school, on purpose.

Cutz by Ant Da Barber is a one-barber shop at 2601 Dawson Road, Suite C10 in Albany, Georgia. No revolving door, no rushed fades for the next chair — just Ant, taking the time to get it right.

The reviews tell the story better than we can: "professional," "on time," "patient with my son," "the old school barber you've been looking for." Eighty-three verified Booksy reviews, and every one of them five stars.

Behind the Chair

Anthony Ross Sr.

Ant cuts everybody — men, kids from their first birthday on, seniors, military, women who keep it short. What stays the same is the approach: a quick conversation about what you want, clean clipper work blended seam-free, and a razor line-up to finish.

Regulars keep a standing two-week appointment. Parents say he's had their sons since they were one. And when the chair is running ahead, he'll get you in early.

See the work on TikTok @cutzbyantdabarber or book directly on Booksy.

The Standard

Family-friendly. Affordable. On time.

Men's haircuts from $35, kids from $15 on Mon–Wed specials, seniors $20. Cash and credit cards accepted. Booking is on Booksy so you always know exactly when you're up.
